definition: Creates framework agreements, provider panels, catalogues or standard procurement routes for cloud services.
Defines service levels, availability, support, security, audit, data ownership and shared responsibilities.
Introduces budgeting, tagging, allocation, consumption monitoring, optimisation and FinOps practices.
Accredits or assesses cloud providers against technical, security, residency and operational requirements.
Requires data export, application portability, transition support, verified deletion and exit procedures.
